context: Rewritten at review on 2026-11-13: the first version guessed a wait timeout or API failure; the log disproves that. Decision gate: classify site defect, core defect or expected before changing anything. Guardrails: do not set SITE_SNAPSHOT_APPROVED_CHANGE or any repository variable; do not dispatch core workflows; do not weaken the parity gate; investigation is read-only until the class is recorded.
description:
Problem: Deploy run 43234165099 (repository_dispatch from core, site commit 802ac09, 2026-11-12 14:08 UTC) failed in `Resolve the bundle and the deployed generation`. The log line is: `deploy: corpus changed but validator_parity covers 21f6710..0eeec0d, not the deployed 01a1515; dispatch core site-inputs.yml with parent_core_sha=...`. So the cause is the snapshot-parity base check, not a fetch timeout: the candidate bundle's validator_parity attestation was computed against a parent that is not the deployed core commit. At least one later dispatch failed too (run 43298467532, core 953e997). Deploys have succeeded since 2026-11-12 23:47 UTC, yet the site-local `site-deploy-failed` issue #58 is still open, last updated 2026-11-12 20:19 UTC.

Outcome: it is known why core produced bundles whose parity base skipped the deployed commit, whether the site or core should have recovered without a person, and whether #58 should have been closed by the successful deploys.
